crossRefs.note: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
translations.bsb: Abraham lived a total of 175 years.
translations.kjv: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
translations.asv: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen years.
